answer: Cap delegated weight at the delegate: an identity may lend its voice, but the total weight any one account can wield, its own plus everything delegated to it, never exceeds what that account could earn alone. Delegation then routes around a sybil instead of multiplying it: a hundred tributaries pouring into one river still make one river, and a quarry that ships all its marble to a single haven has not built a second city. Influence pools; it cannot be cloned.
